pride_data.title: Structural analysis of the CSN complex to understand its inhibition mechanism
pride_data.projectDescription: We performed interaction and structural analyses to unravel the molecular mechanisms underlying CSN inhibition. Various methods including Cryo-EM, cross-linking mass spectrometry, quantitative mass spectrometry and biochemical assays have been employed to define inhibitor-induced interaction and structural changes of the CSN complex in vitro and in cells.
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: To assemble the COP9-N8CRL1 complex for cross-linking, the CSNwt concentration was adjusted to 6.8uM, and N8CRL1 to 30uM. Then, 7µL of CSN and 4.8uL of N8CRL1 were mixed and incubated on ice for 10s or 30min. For the i3 treated samples, the CSNwt was first incubated with i3 at a molar ratio of 1:10 for 30min on ice, then mixed with N8CRL1 the same as above. After incubation, the complexes were cross-linked with DSSO at a molar ratio of 1:100 (protein to linker) for 1h at room temperature.
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: LC MS3 data were searched using Protein Prospector (v6.3.5; http://prospector.ucsf.edu/prospector/mshome.htm). Cross-linked peptides were identified through the integration of MS1, MS2 and MS3 data using XL-tools scripts. MaxQuant (v2.0.3.0) was used for DDA-based label-free quantitation, and DIA-NN (v2.0.2) was used for DIA-based quantitation.
